::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/receipts"}
#docs
Keyset pagination (`limit`, `starting_after`). Filters: `created_at`, `paid_at`, `amount_minor`, `currency`, `number` with `<field>[<op>]`.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `customer` | `string` | no | Only this customer's receipts (cus_…). |
| `payment` | `string` | no | Only the receipt of this payment (pay_…). |
| `payment_request` | `string` | no | Only receipts of this payment request (preq_…). |
| `invoice` | `string` | no | Only receipts with money applied to this invoice (inv_…). |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size. Default 50. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | The cursor from the previous page's `next_cursor`. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid filter |
